InTheCyber, est. 2008, has ten years’ experience in auditing and consulting for Cyber Defense.
We work under 2 perspectives: the Offensive approach and the Defensive approach.
With the Offensive approach (Red team), we verify the real effectiveness of the Defense measures and technologies adopted to protect corporates’ and institutions’ infrastructures from Cyber Threat. This means performing a series of simulations of attacks in order to challenge networks, systems, applications, people of the selected target, individuating weakness points and exploiting them.
With the Defensive approach (Blue Team), we cooperate with the Customer team towards the full establishment of a continuous presidium of the Cyber Security. This goes through procedural and technical auditing, hardening projects, advanced threat early detection, education and technology scouting. Moreover we provide full Manged Detection & Response Service in order to intercept and block residual Attacks.
The White Team is dedicated in auditing & consulting towards Cyber Security Governance.A particular attention is held in this period to the national and international laws on Data & Assets Protection, European GDPR and NIS.

entityDescription:
The Geological Survey of Sweden – SGU – is the expert agency for issues relating to bedrock, soil and groundwater in Sweden.
One key task is to meet society's need for geological information but SGU is also responsible for the Good-Quality Groundwater objective, which also involves reducing the use of natural gravel.
Important tasks are:
Supporting the development of the mining, rock and mineral industry
Promoting the use of geological information in societal planning
Uniting and strengthening geological research in Sweden
Bringing geology and geological knowledge to the fore in social debate and in schools
In addition, the Swedish Mining Inspectorate is a separate decision-making body within SGU. It is responsible for issuing permits for minerals exploration and extraction under the Swedish Minerals Act (1991:45). SGU currently has around 280 employees, with the majority being stationed in Uppsala. Others are stationed at our regional offices in Gothenburg, Lund, Stockholm, Malå, and Luleå (Mining Inspectorate). Our annual turnover is around SEK 340 million.

entityDescription:
The aim of the HERADO group company is to transforming the way that the facilities manage the radiation monitoring programs.
HERADO company provide complete radiation dosimetry services, including the research, development, distribution and collection of various types of radiation detection monitors and the analysis and reporting of exposure findings.

With our dosimeters in your faculty you can increase dosimetry compliance with very low dose limits, small size and weight and long battery life time. 

The ALMAR detector is accepted to be upload on EM-1 mission on Moon with Orion vehicle of NASA. 
Applications 
Space Applications
This technology could become a novel part of radiation protection strategy for astronauts, broadening the spectrum and depth of current radiation exposure assessment and improving risk assessment. This could lead to improved/tailored radiation protection for individual astronauts or as a collective. More importantly it provides the means to make (quasi-) instant decisions based on the radiation environment at any moment in time. Furthermore, looking ahead to future exploration missions outside of low Earth orbit, this type of technology provides an accurately monitor astronaut exposure during a mission and possibly make adaptations to protocols for radiation protection. 

Earth Applications

This type of technology has application on Earth in the monitoring of personnel involved in areas where radiation can be a significant factor, such as medical, military, in the nuclear power industry, or in high altitude professions. This technology could also find application for monitoring in areas on Earth with naturally high levels of background radiation (e.g mines).

entityName: Consorzio Italiano per il Telerilevamento dell'Ambiente e dell'Agricoltura
entityDescription:
Consorzio ITA was established 1978 to develop the application of remote sensing applied to agriculture statistics. Actually the members of the Consortium are: ENVICAST S.r.L. and Cooprogetti soc. coop.. Since 1978 ITA has developed technologies and know-how in various sectors of statistics applications to agriculture, mainly in area sampling frame, ground surveys and quality assurance and control dedicated to the production of agriculture statistics. ITA is a leader in the production of agricultural and woodland statistics, both through joint processing of ground truth data and of remote sensing images and farmer interviews. It also has extensive experience in different environmental ground phenomena modeling and in the production of thematic maps.
It develops and implements geographic information systems to manage the graphic and alphanumerical data related to environmental projects.
Since 1992 ITA is involved in the IACS for the remote sensing application and in this sector has developed the EUROPAC software for managing geographical and alfa-numerical data related to agricultural parcel control using GIS and satellite images.
Several EU projects were carried out by Consorzio ITA including: rapid estimates (MiniSites), agricultural statistics (Regional inventories, Lucas 2001 and 2003), olive trees statistics (Oli stat, Oli area) .

entityDescription:
GEO University is a registered Estonian company in Tallinn.
The name stands for: GIS (Geographical Information Systems) and Earth Observation (GEO). Beside being incorporated, GEO University consists of a group of professionals and experts in their corresponding fields. We are dedicated to create and deliver our knowledge and solutions to students, professionals, decision makers and scientists who want to introduce or enhance their knowledge in these fields or even get a solution to their geospatial problem.
Our team of professionals and experts will guide you through the following topics:

1. Geographical Information System (GIS)
2. WebGIS
3. Remote Sensing/Earth Observation
4. Photogrammetry
5. LiDAR
6. Satellite Cloud Processing
7. R and Python programming
8. Data visualization

We are constantly adding new courses and new fields of expertise. Our courses vary from simple note collections, books (for people who have constrained time to study) to complete lectures with exercises, quizzes (for people who are willing to dive into and extract the maximum value from the course).
Our courses are not only basic the theoretical principles of each field, but we also create tutorial courses for specific open-source and commercial software. We constantly add and update courses so you get the best of experience!
To maximize our student learning experience we are partnering with cloud service providers, Earth Observation adding value companies, GIS experts and many more.

entityDescription:
MEDeus is a company that focuses on providing services to healthcare organisations. This includes the delivery of medical payloads using autonomous UAV's (drones), data collection and management as well as consultation services regarding said data. 
Within the UK, as a developed nation, our focus is to increase the health intelligence of our rural communities. Public Health England has reported that we simply do not know enough about our rural population's health. With more than 11 million rural residents in the UK, a significant proportion of our citizens would benefit from the data analysis performed by our service. Moreover, the data we collect can be used by both research institutions and governments alike to allow better targeted resource allocation. We aim to perform big data analysis on the data we collect from patients to produce disease models and predictive algorithms that can monitor and determine when and how diseases spread and even stopping a deadly outbreak before it even happens. Patients would also benefit from increased autonomy over their health information which would lead to better education and understanding of their condition, thus reducing pressures on hospitals and primary care services within the NHS as patients take greater control over their health. Clinicians can benefit from a more modern way of treating and managing patients at a distance using our data service in conjunction with our drone service. The potential for telemedicine to connect those isolated and remote practices within the United Kingdom is greater than we realise. 
Further to this, our unique and clever method of data collection would be of enormous benefit to developing nations whose populations suffer from a chronic lack of access to healthcare. Our service can collect data that would otherwise never be utilised. We could manage large quantities of gold standard, real-time data to produce the best predictive algorithms possible in order to control a range of infectious diseases that are otherwise unstoppable. This not only saves lives by preventing outbreaks in developing nations but also has downstream positive effects on developed nations by reducing the risk of such infectious diseases being transmitted through borders.

entityDescription:
Yarix was founded in 2001. The company is completely focused on issues related to computer security and in recent years has become a primary point of reference for Law Enforcement Agencies in the field of forensic investigation. Since 2014 Yarix has been a subsidiary of VAR Group S.p.A. (see table for some more relevant Group company data) and constitutes the Security Business Unit, specialized in providing services in the field of Cyber Security. 
 
 Yarix is headquartered in Montebelluna, in the province of Treviso, where the SOC, one of the main corporate assets is also located. Through its close partnership with VAR Group Data Center in Empoli, it can guarantee a 24/7 365 monitoring service with continuous supervision supplied in three rotating shifts. 
In addition to Montebelluna, Yarix has offices in Milan, Rome and Tel Aviv where it is present with an R&D Center, which is focused on the study of attack and intrusion techniques used by Cybercriminals. 
The value of Yarix lies in the company know-how, in the advanced technologies employed and in all the innovative applications developed and distributed globally in the security field. The company’s depth of experience, highly qualified and certified staff, continuous investments in research in the field of information security confirm its position as a market leader in the field of Information Technology. 
Yarix regularly provides forensic analysis courses to public institutions, Law Enforcement Agencies and private institutions, imparting the technical knowledge necessary for using the most advanced software in this field.
